list.name: region
list.label: Region
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "snmp", tag: "region", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "interface", start: -1h)

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "snmp", tag: "site", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}), start: -1h)

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "snmp", tag: "sys_name", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}), start: -1h)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "interface_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["sys_name"])
  |> unique(column: "sys_name")
  |> count(column: "sys_name")

from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "interface_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value == 1 then 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "interface_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 2)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "bytes_in")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 1.0, _field: "in"}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "bytes_out")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 1.0, _field: "out"}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

traffic = from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "bytes_in")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 8.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["sys_name", "interface_name", "site", "region", "_value"])
  |> group()

speed = from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "speed_mbps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["sys_name", "interface_name", "_value"])
  |> group()

join(tables: {t: traffic, s: speed}, on: ["sys_name", "interface_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Device: r.sys_name, Port: r.interface_name, Site: r.site, Region: r.region, "Traffic": r._value_t, "Load": r._value_t / (float(v: r._value_s) * 1000000.0) * 100.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Load"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["Load"])

targets.query:
status = from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "interface_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["region", "site", "sys_name"])
  |> reduce(fn: (r, accumulator) => ({Ports: accumulator.Ports + 1, Down: accumulator.Down + (if r._value == 2 then 1 else 0)}), identity: {Ports: 0, Down: 0})
  |> group()

traffic = from(bucket: "snmp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "bytes_in")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.region, set: ${region:json}) and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.sys_name, set: ${device:json}))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 8.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["region", "site", "sys_name"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()

join(tables: {s: status, t: traffic}, on: ["region", "site", "sys_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Region: r.region, Site: r.site, Device: r.sys_name, Ports: r.Ports, Down: r.Down, Traffic: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Region", "Site", "Device"])
